reply.text:
Good on you for wanting to get started. At 13, the thing to know is that abs come from steady, patient work, and there's no fast version. A parent and your doctor are the right people to talk through any plan aimed at changing how your body looks, so start there, and I'll be glad to help with the training once they're on board.

What I can say as your coach is that it's smart to learn good movement now: bodyweight basics like planks, squats, push-ups and some sport or play you enjoy. Do you want to talk about what you like to do for training?
